topic: Boa Hancock never swore a vow to Luffy aloud, but five costly acts show a vow she has kept since Impel Down
title: Boa Hancock Kept Her Vow To Luffy For Years
description:
Boa Hancock Luffy explained: she never swore a spoken oath to him, yet five costly choices from Impel Down to Amazon Lily and Egghead say she made one. I walk through the robe, the key, the kick, the refused surrender and the stand against Blackbeard, then give the strongest case against my theory.

Is this a real vow, or just a gag Oda keeps running? Pick a side in the comments.

0:00 The Oath Aimed Elsewhere
0:35 A Robe Full Of Trouble
2:30 Her Only Spoken Oath
comment: Is Hancock's loyalty to Luffy a real vow she has kept for years, or a crush Oda plays for laughs? Pick one.
